title: Wildland Tools & Equipment
description: Wildfire tools and equipment for PMW
body: This Mod adds Varous wildland firefighting tools such as the Pulaski wich has a axe head and a part on the back for clearing fuel, The Mcleod wich has a cutting side for touching up the fire line and a rake side to clear grass,leaf litters, twigs and sticks, and is normally at the front and back ensuring that the line is clear of fuel to stop the fire The Fireshelter gives fire protection and regeneration to heal you and will hold you still like in real life finally The Driptorch wich is a tool that drops small bits of fire to do what is called Backburning Or controlled Burning. This mod is still in beta and there will be more coming soon, this is a addon to the ProtoManly's Weather mod for the new update that adds wildfires that can start with lightning, one reason you should download this mod is to protect your and your friends bases in a server/world and allows realistic fighting of the dangerous blaze.
